# laravelforge_recipe (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge recipe by ID within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the recipe.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Recipe name.
- `script` (String) Shell script executed by the recipe.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `user` (String) User the recipe runs as (`root` or `forge`).
